description: Inventory, classification and security review of the 21 original skills. CORE and OPTIONAL skills have a portable manifest; QUARANTINED and DEPRECATED skills are recorded as factual metadata only and none of their instruction text is copied. origin.sha256 is the digest of the original SKILL.md so the unmodified originals can be re-verified.

license.evidence: Recorded provenance (not re-checked at test time): official upstream https://github.com/supabase/agent-skills, source snapshot commit f421451c7956d9a79b8257ccc24a7ab6d16037e2, path skills/supabase-postgres-best-practices. The official repository root LICENSE (https://github.com/supabase/agent-skills/blob/main/LICENSE) is MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Supabase; the skill frontmatter at that commit declares MIT. The full text is shipped in licenses/supabase-postgres-best-practices-MIT.md. Of the 37 files in the original skill, 30 rule files are carried over byte-for-byte (identical to the upstream commit); the other 7 (SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, metadata.json and the rule-authoring files _contributing.md, _template.md, _sections.md) are not carried over verbatim; SKILL.md is rewritten as portable instructions.

provenance.license_scope: Official MIT LICENSE at the upstream repository root (observed on main; the root file is not present at source_commit). The skill's own SKILL.md frontmatter at source_commit declares MIT. The carried snapshot corresponds to source_commit, not current main.

skills.minimum_permissions: Read, Grep, Glob only. Guidance for writing and reviewing SQL; executing SQL is out of scope.
risks: Applying guidance to a live database without review could cause lock contention or data loss; the portable instructions forbid executing SQL against production.
Source README references npm install and build steps for contributors; those are not part of the portable skill.
The carried snapshot corresponds to upstream commit f421451c..., not current main; upstream rules may have changed since.
conflicts: Overlaps with the backend-expert agent data-access rules; complementary, not conflicting.
Source SKILL.md references a rule file that does not exist (schema-partial-indexes.md); the portable instructions point to the real query-partial-indexes.md.
skills.rationale: Priority domain (Supabase/PostgreSQL). Self-contained, no external service, no credentials, no commands. Approved with attribution and notice. The compiled AGENTS.md duplicate and contributor files are not carried over.

license.evidence: LICENSE.txt in the skill directory contains the full Apache License 2.0 text and SKILL.md frontmatter points to it. The snapshot does not name the copyright holder.
